content.short: Repute X provides the reputeX Score, a numeric metric of creditworthiness and on-chain behavior.
content.description: Repute X delivers the ReputeX Score, a numeric rating computed from a mix of on-chain signals including the applications used, an address’s usage history, and insights drawn from chain analysis such as ENS domains and NFT holdings. Started in September 2022, this score is designed to reflect creditworthiness and on-chain behavior, offering a data-driven view of an entity’s trust profile across supported networks like Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Solana, Arbitrum, and Base.
content.meta: Repute X provides the reputeX Score indicating creditworthiness and on-chain behavior. Discover Repute X and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
